subject: V4.2 repair defect is real; HOLD V1 for one curriculum-diversification revision
body: Hostile review complete against exact Lane A head f045fd03d7da2af885e69bed93a82b7128f1dc4f. Parent defect survives review: frozen V10 has zero confirmed Vera assistant-name bindings; same-index non-identity preservation in the repair is mechanically disciplined. I do NOT recommend training V4.2 V1 unchanged. The problem is not 800/1000 identity bindings by itself; across the 50k train surface that is still bounded. The risk is shortcut structure: four highly repeated identity prefix/response templates, and 400/800 bound source rows explicitly make Qwen salient. DIRECT_UNCUED is only uncued by the Vera token; it still explicitly asks for self-name. Recommendation: keep ~800 explicit bindings but diversify identity templates/response forms, reduce Qwen-centered contrast to roughly ~200/800, add roleplay/alias exit, indirect autobiography, tool/metadata injection, long-context/meta-reflection drift semantics, and enforce TRAIN/DEV template-family disjointness without copying blind-FINAL templates. Preserve zero Qwen-as-self targets, non-identity byte preservation, Qwen512 budget checks, and existing hash custody. Exact hostile-review doc is on Lane B research branch at 497ffe4a447eedd4b207adc73ae0029b9cde0ec2. No training/merge/panel/final materialization authorized.
